grade.first_issue: The claim that every triangle containing an angle in the modular set W_theta is winning is false: when an angle alpha<theta is changed to alpha+theta, subsequently subtracting theta can simply return to alpha, so Shan-Yu may cycle between these states rather than eventually permit theta.
grade.summary: The claimed characterization is wrong: the correct values are theta=180°/n for integers n>=2, not all rational multiples of 180° at most 90°. The proof's central modular-angle invariant does not imply finite victory, its main forcing cut in Section 2 is geometrically invalid, and the necessity argument is unsupported. Substantial new ideas—particularly the safe-triangle obstruction—are required.
strengths: The valid peeling observation for an angle alpha>theta correctly produces one child containing theta and another containing alpha-theta.
The altitude construction correctly proves the special case theta=90°.
The submission recognizes that Mulan must account for either child being retained.

errors.description: Membership in W_theta modulo 180° does not support the asserted reduction to theta. For example, with theta=72°, the residues 36° and 108° lie in W_theta, but the proposed increase and reduction steps can alternate 36°↔108° indefinitely.

The principal forcing cut in Section 2 is invalid. Setting phi=180°-beta-theta while assuming gamma>theta gives phi=alpha+gamma-theta>alpha, so phi cannot be one part of the angle alpha. Equivalently, the alleged second child has the negative angle theta-gamma.

The necessity argument does not establish a strategy for Shan-Yu over multiple moves. Avoiding a cut whose two children both immediately contain theta is not enough; one must prove that at least one child remains non-winning after every cut.

The proposed irrational obstruction is invalid: alpha,beta,gamma cannot be algebraically independent over a field containing 180° because alpha+beta+gamma=180°. The further claim that an angle in W_theta cannot be forced is merely asserted.
The statement W_theta={theta} for theta>90° is false, for example theta=120° also gives the residue 60°, and irrational theta gives a dense modular orbit.
